title: MCP Todo Server Error Codes
description: Standardized error codes and response format for MCP tool operations

errorFormat.description: All errors follow this standard format

details.description: Optional additional context (never exposes internal details)

errorCodes.description: The specified task does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated user
causes: Task ID does not exist in database
Task belongs to a different user (ownership check failed)
errorCodes.resolution: Verify the task ID is correct and belongs to the authenticated user

errorCodes.description: Input validation failed - one or more parameters are invalid
errorCodes.resolution: Check the details field for specific validation errors and correct the input

errorCodes.description: Authentication failed - missing or invalid JWT token
errorCodes.resolution: Provide a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer scheme)

errorCodes.description: User is authenticated but attempting to access another user's resource
causes: Task belongs to a different user
User ID in token does not match resource owner
errorCodes.resolution: Only access your own tasks - cannot access other users' resources

errorCodes.description: Optimistic concurrency conflict - task was modified by another request
causes: Task version mismatch (task was updated since it was read)
Concurrent update from another AI agent or client
errorCodes.resolution: Retry the operation with fresh task data (re-fetch the task first)

error.message: Task was modified by another request. Please retry with fresh data.

errorCodes.description: Temporary database unavailability - service cannot connect to database
errorCodes.resolution: Retry the operation after a short delay - this is a temporary issue

error.message: Database temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

errorCodes.description: Unexpected server error - something went wrong that wasn't anticipated
errorCodes.resolution: Report this error to system administrators - this indicates a bug

forAIAgents: Parse the 'code' field for programmatic error handling
Display the 'message' field to users for human-readable context
Check 'details' field for additional context (e.g., validation errors)
Implement retry logic for DATABASE_ERROR (temporary failures)
Re-fetch data and retry for CONFLICT errors (optimistic locking)
Do not retry UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, or INVALID_INPUT errors
forDevelopers: Never expose internal details (stack traces, SQL queries) in error responses
Always include the error code for machine readability
Provide actionable messages that guide users toward resolution
Use details field sparingly - only for debugging context
Log full error details server-side for debugging
Map all exceptions to one of these standard error codes
